description: Discovery (register_protocol_impl_providers) records a provider POINTER to the enclosing module; the impl is defined only when that host module's body publishes. Change discovery so each defimpl gives module reference_protocol_impl_module(protocol,target) (= 'Enumerable.List') its own ModuleSourceKind::Body (the impl's forms), demandable via DefineModule(Protocol.Target) directly, independent of the host module. Resolve the defimpl's protocol/target against its OWN lexical namespace (folds in .14: namespace-accurate resolution for aliased/local refs in nested scopes). Keep existing dispatch working. Signal: a nested defimpl can be defined without defining its host module.
title: Register each defimpl as an independent Protocol.Target module body source
